title: The jump-inversion verification drops jump primes and reverses the generalized-low inequality.
details: Marks2024-02-25, Theorem20.7 proof, p81, visually checked. After constructing A from B above the halting set, the comparisons must read A join empty-jump reducible to B and B reducible to A join empty-jump; the plain empty-set occurrences in those sentences must retain primes. The last paragraph should use A-jump reducible to A join empty-jump by1-genericity, followed by A join empty-jump reducible to A-jump from the two general jump lower bounds. The printed A reducible-above A join empty-jump assertion is false. These local corrections establish A-jump equivalent to B without changing the extension-and-coding construction.
